messages.author: Sorcery: Contested Realm #announcements
messages.content:
@everyone We're just one week away from #gen-con - it's time to gather your pack! 

This year's Convention Promo, Grey Wolves, celebrates the friendships that make Sorcery so special.

Reimagined by fantasy artist Jeff Menges, the 2026 Sorcery Convention Promo will be available at Gen Con, the Auckland Card Show, Avatar of the Realm, and select Old School events throughout the year, while supplies last. 

Take a look at Jeff's early sketches and find out how to claim your own Grey Wolves at Gen Con: https://sorcerytcg.com/news/gather-your-pack-sorcery-s-2026-convention-promo 

We can't wait to see you on the floor of Gen Con next week! 🐺

@everyoneThe Codex has grown wiser, yet again!

This latest changelog brings new FAQ entries for the Courts and other cards, along with updates to **Mirage** and **Lord of Lies**.

*Don’t trust his words - it’s in the name! *

See everything that’s changed: https://curiosa.io/codex/changelog  

Additionally, the Courts can now be found on Curiosa.io for those looking to brew some decks!

messages.author: Sorcery: Contested Realm #announcements
messages.content:
@everyone  
# All Rise! ⚖️

The court is **now** in session.

Four new Dust Reward promo cards are now LIVE in the Rewards Store and ready to be claimed with your Dust!

Read more about the new rewards here:
https://www.sorcerytcg.com/news/all-rise-new-dust-rewards-are-here

And while we’re celebrating the Courts, please join us in welcoming Franck Pawlowski to the Realm! 

Mock Court is Franck’s first Sorcery illustration and we’re thrilled to have him as part of the growing family of Sorcery artists.

Meet Franck here: https://www.sorcerytcg.com/news/welcome-to-sorcery-franck-pawlowski
